Before Lynkr writes comments

  • Lynkr reads only the text you select on LinkedIn, when you choose Write with Lynkr.
  • That text, your reaction and up to 12 of your saved facts that are safe in public are sent to Lynkr to write the options. The post itself is not saved.
  • You press Post yourself. Lynkr never posts, likes or sends anything.
